description: A 5 V breadboard-friendly board with an ATmega328P, an FT232RNL USB-serial chip, 14 digital pins, 8 analog inputs and an ICSP header.
summary: The board runs the user's sketch in the iynk interpreter. Pins, PWM, I2C, serial and timing follow the nano board profile. It is not the ATmega328P chip.

models.1: Arduino-C++ subset run by the interpreter with the Nano pin map.
models.2: Digital I/O on D0 to D13 and A0 to A5, PWM on D3, D5, D6, D9, D10 and D11, interrupts on D2 and D3.
models.3: 10-bit analog reads against a 5 V reference on A0 to A7, I2C master on SDA and SCL, serial output, and the L LED on D13.

not.1: The AVR core, timers, bootloader and flash behaviour.
not.2: The FT232RNL USB-serial bridge and the auto-reset circuit.
not.3: The 5 V and 3.3 V regulators, the VIN limits and the brown-out level.
not.4: EEPROM wear and the ICSP header.

gap: A6 and A7 are analog inputs only: digitalRead and pinMode do not work on them. No electrical ratings are listed yet, so no pin-overload check exists for this board.
